newsitem.title: INDIA: India Rhone-Poulenc to pay royalties.
newsitem.headline: India Rhone-Poulenc to pay royalties.

text.p: Pharmaceutical firm Rhone-Poulenc (India) Ltd said on Thursday it will begin paying royalties to France's Rhone-Poulenc Rorer SA (RPR), its principal shareholder, from April 1, 1997.
The firm's board decided to pay royalty of three percent on domestic sales and five percent on export sales, the company said in a statement.
It will also pay lumpsum technical fees of 10 million rupees in three instalments.
"In the past because of regulatory constraints, no payments was made to RPR but the group continued to allow its global technology and trade marks to be used in India," the statement said.
